about: C6a Steam Settings (SET §5, PLAN §1.7). No pops and no plates: Settings is one flat window on 00-base's window cover (C1a's data-lgs-glass="window"). The +10 mm hero pop (settings-hero, .DialogHeader::before) was removed on 2026-10-07 (wearer report, Settings > Audio): every pop cuts main's base mosaic into guillotine pieces, and on the main window those pieces did not stay coplanar with each other and with the cover off axis (headset view: the content pane a skewed trapezoid off its glass, the hero and title on a separate offset piece, the search capsule loose above, the sidebar on its own piece). One uncut base piece lines up with the cover; flat and correct beats popped and broken (PLAN §1.7 admission is optional for a decorative pop). The hero circle stays a flat CSS element. Menus, alerts and sheets opened from settings pages are C1c's (22-presentations.json). Behind wp.c6a.
